title: Tesla Model 3's motor - The Brilliant Engineering behind it
summary: An engineering explainer on why Tesla abandoned the induction motor for the Model 3 and used an IPM-SynRM design. It covers the reluctance torque and permanent magnet principles behind the choice.
why: HN recommends it as a clear explanation of the Model 3 motor and reluctance rotor design.
